# Vague Description

This skill is structurally valid — it loads fine — but its description is too
short and names no trigger condition, so Claude will rarely know when to fire
it. It passes structural checks yet earns warnings, landing it in the middle of
the score range.

## Workflow

1. Load without error.
2. Collect description warnings.
